versions.changelog: Ask before delegating, changing configuration or overwriting files.

Initial release of oceantoken-setup skill to configure OceanToken as a model provider for Codex, Claude Code, and custom applications.

- Guides users to switch Codex or Claude Code to OceanToken models.
- Provides step-by-step instructions for setting/using the OCEANTOKEN_API_KEY and managing API keys securely.
- Includes configuration examples for Codex and Claude Code, with tips for safe key storage.
- Details integration steps for applications using OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs.
- Outlines troubleshooting for common OceanToken API errors (401, 403, budget, etc.).
- Supports related requests in Chinese.
